::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 35,199 people lived in County Leitrim, up 9.8% on 2016. It had the smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 23% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Leitrim was €992, the second lowest of the 26 counties.
:::
